# 1066 Airsoft

> 1066 Airsoft is set in acres of battle ready countryside on the outskirts of Hastings. Teamwork, strategy and skill, across a wide variety of missions played out in our own battlezones: open fields with bases and barricades, and camouflaged woodland.

1066 Airsoft is an outdoor airsoft site at Adams Fruit Farm, Ivyhouse Lane, Hastings, East Sussex TN35 4NN, United Kingdom.

## Key facts

- Price: from £30 per person for a full day
- Minimum age: 10 years attained; under 16s need written parental permission
- Minimum group size to hold an event: 10 players
- Runs fortnightly on Sundays, all year, by prior booking
- Booking is through Eventbrite: https://www.eventbrite.com/e/airsoft-skirmish-event-tickets-1095218440839?aff=oddtdtcreator
- Telephone 07722 22 1066 (24 hour answering service), email dom@1066airsoft.com
- Battlezones: The Village, Hellfire Hill, The Jungle
- UKARA registered site; registration £15 a year
- Gates open 08:00 and close 09:00; chrono from 08:30; safety briefing 09:30 to 10:00
- Lunch around 12:30, for about 45 minutes; we close around 15:30
